verses.20: The Lord has remembered us, and blessed us: he has blessed the house of Israel, he has blessed the house of Aaron.
verses.21: He has blessed them that fear the Lord, both small and great.
verses.22: The Lord add blessings to you and to your children.
verses.23: Blessed are ye of the Lord, who made the heaven and the earth.
verses.24: The heaven of heavens belongs to the Lord: but he has given the earth to the sons of men.
verses.25: The dead shall not praise thee, O Lord, nor any that go down to Hades.
verses.26: But we, the living, will bless the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.

verses.1: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias. Praise ye the Lord: for psalmody is a good thing; let praise be sweetly sung to our God.
verses.2: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; and he will gather together the dispersed of Israel.
verses.3: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verses.4: He numbers the multitudes of stars; and calls them all by names.
verses.5: Great is our Lord, and great is his strength; and his understanding is infinite.
verses.6: The Lord lifts up the meek; but brings sinners down to the ground.
verses.7: Begin the song with thanksgiving to the Lord; sing praises on the harp to our God:
verses.8: who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who causes grass to spring up on the mountains, [and green herb for the service of men;]
verses.9: and gives to cattle their food, and to the young ravens that call upon him.
verses.10: He will not take pleasure in the strength of a horse; neither is he well-pleased with the legs of a man.
verses.11: The Lord takes pleasure in them that fear him, and in all that hope in his mercy.

verses.1: A Song of Degrees. Blessed are all they that fear the Lord; who walk in his ways.
verses.2: Thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.
verses.3: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine on the sides of thy house: thy children as young olive-plants round about thy table.
verses.4: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed that fears the Lord.
verses.5: May the Lord bless thee out of Sion; and mayest thou see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.
verses.6: And mayest thou see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel.

verses.1: A Psalm for David, of Aggæus and Zacharias. I will give thee thanks, O Lord, with my whole heart; and I will sing psalms to thee before the angels; for thou hast heard all the words of my mouth.
verses.2: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and give thanks to thy name, on account of thy mercy and thy truth; for thou hast magnified thy holy name above every thing.
verses.3: In whatsoever day I shall call upon thee, hear me speedily; thou shalt abundantly provide me with thy power in my soul.
verses.4: Let all the kings of the earth, O Lord, give thanks unto thee; for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.
verses.5: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord; for great is the glory of the Lord.
verses.6: For the Lord is high, and yet regards the lowly; and he knows high things from afar off.
verses.7: Though I should walk in the midst of affliction, thou wilt quicken me; thou hast stretched forth thine hands against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand has saved me.
verses.8: O Lord, thou shalt recompense them on my behalf: thy mercy, O Lord, endures for ever: overlook not the works of thine hands.

verses.1: Alleluia, a Psalm of Aggæus and Zacharias. Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Sion.
verses.2: For he has strengthened the bars of thy gates; he has blessed thy children within thee.
verses.3: He makes thy borders peaceful, and fills thee with the flour of wheat.
verses.4: He sends his oracle to the earth: his word will run swiftly.
verses.5: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the mist like ashes.
verses.6: Casting forth his ice like morsels: who shall stand before his cold?
verses.7: He shall send out his word, and melt them: he shall blow with his wind, and the waters shall flow.
verses.8: He sends his word to Jacob, his ordinances and judgments to Israel.
verses.9: He has not done so to any other nation; and he has not shewn them his judgments.

bible/NKJV-003.html.title: Psalm 3 NKJV - The Lord Helps His Troubled People - A - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Lord , how they have increased who trouble me! Many are they who rise up against me.
verses.2: Many are they who say of me, “ There is no help for him in God.” Selah
verses.3: But You, O Lord , are a shield for me, My glory and the One who lifts up my head.
verses.4: I cried to the Lord with my voice, And He heard me from His holy hill. Selah
verses.5: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the Lord sustained me.
verses.6: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who have set themselves against me all around.
verses.7: Arise, O Lord ; Save me, O my God! For You have struck all my enemies on the cheekbone; You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.8: Salvation belongs to the Lord . Your blessing is upon Your people. Selah

bible/NKJV-005.html.title: Psalm 5 NKJV - A Prayer for Guidance - To the Chief - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Give ear to my words, O Lord , Consider my meditation.
verses.2: Give heed to the voice of my cry, My King and my God, For to You I will pray.
verses.3: My voice You shall hear in the morning, O Lord ; In the morning I will direct it to You, And I will look up.
verses.4: For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness, Nor shall evil dwell with You.
verses.5: The boastful shall not stand in Your sight; You hate all workers of iniquity.
verses.6: You shall destroy those who speak falsehood; The Lord abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
verses.7: But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy; In fear of You I will worship toward Your holy temple.
verses.8: Lead me, O Lord , in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make Your way straight before my face.
verses.9: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is destruction; Their throat is an open tomb; They flatter with their tongue.
verses.10: Pronounce them guilty, O God! Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, For they have rebelled against You.
verses.11: But let all those rejoice who put their trust in You; Let them ever shout for joy, because You defend them; Let those also who love Your name Be joyful in You.
verses.12: For You, O Lord , will bless the righteous; With favor You will surround him as with a shield.

bible/NKJV-008.html.title: Psalm 8 NKJV - The Glory of the Lord in Creation - To - Bible Gateway

verses.1: O Lord , our Lord, How excellent is Your name in all the earth, Who have set Your glory above the heavens!
verses.2: Out of the mouth of babes and nursing infants You have ordained strength, Because of Your enemies, That You may silence the enemy and the avenger.
verses.3: When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, The moon and the stars, which You have ordained,
verses.4: What is man that You are mindful of him, And the son of man that You visit him?
verses.5: For You have made him a little lower than the angels, And You have crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.6: You have made him to have dominion over the works of Your hands; You have put all things under his feet,
verses.7: All sheep and oxen— Even the beasts of the field,
verses.8: The birds of the air, And the fish of the sea That pass through the paths of the seas.
verses.9: O Lord , our Lord, How excellent is Your name in all the earth!

verses.6: There are many who say, “Who will show us any good?” Lord , lift up the light of Your countenance upon us.
verses.7: You have put gladness in my heart, More than in the season that their grain and wine increased.
verses.8: I will both lie down in peace, and sleep; For You alone, O Lord , make me dwell in safety.

bible/NKJV-018.html.title: Psalm 18 NKJV - God the Sovereign Savior - To the Chief - Bible Gateway

verses.1: I will love You, O Lord , my strength.
verses.2: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer; My God, my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
verses.3: I will call upon the Lord , who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.4: The pangs of death surrounded me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
verses.5: The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
verses.6: In my distress I called upon the Lord , And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry came before Him, even to His ears.
verses.7: Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.
verses.8: Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.
verses.9: He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.
verses.10: And He rode upon a cherub, and flew; He flew upon the wings of the wind.
verses.11: He made darkness His secret place; His canopy around Him was dark waters And thick clouds of the skies.
verses.12: From the brightness before Him, His thick clouds passed with hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.13: The Lord thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.14: He sent out His arrows and scattered the foe, Lightnings in abundance, and He vanquished them.
verses.15: Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered At Your rebuke, O Lord , At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
verses.16: He sent from above, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.17: He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me, For they were too strong for me.
verses.18: They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the Lord was my support.
verses.19: He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.
verses.20: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.
verses.21: For I have kept the ways of the Lord , And have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.22: For all His judgments were before me, And I did not put away His statutes from me.
verses.23: I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.24: Therefore the Lord has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
verses.25: With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;
verses.26: With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.
verses.27: For You will save the humble people, But will bring down haughty looks.
verses.28: For You will light my lamp; The Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.
verses.29: For by You I can run against a troop, By my God I can leap over a wall.
verses.30: As for God, His way is perfect; The word of the Lord is proven; He is a shield to all who trust in Him.
verses.31: For who is God, except the Lord ? And who is a rock, except our God?
verses.32: It is God who arms me with strength, And makes my way perfect.
verses.33: He makes my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places.
verses.34: He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
verses.35: You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your right hand has held me up, Your gentleness has made me great.
verses.36: You enlarged my path under me, So my feet did not slip.
verses.37: I have pursued my enemies and overtaken them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.
verses.38: I have wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.
verses.39: For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
verses.40: You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.
verses.41: They cried out, but there was none to save; Even to the Lord , but He did not answer them.
verses.42: Then I beat them as fine as the dust before the wind; I cast them out like dirt in the streets.
verses.43: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; You have made me the head of the nations; A people I have not known shall serve me.
verses.44: As soon as they hear of me they obey me; The foreigners submit to me.
verses.45: The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.
verses.46: The Lord lives! Blessed be my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.
verses.47: It is God who avenges me, And subdues the peoples under me;
verses.48: He delivers me from my enemies. You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.
verses.49: Therefore I will give thanks to You, O Lord , among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.
verses.50: Great deliverance He gives to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore.

bible/NKJV-019.html.title: Psalm 19 NKJV - The Perfect Revelation of the Lord - To - Bible Gateway

verses.1: The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament shows His handiwork.
verses.2: Day unto day utters speech, And night unto night reveals knowledge.
verses.3: There is no speech nor language Where their voice is not heard.
verses.4: Their line has gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.5: Which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoices like a strong man to run its race.
verses.6: Its rising is from one end of heaven, And its circuit to the other end; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.
verses.7: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul; The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple;
verses.8: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes;
verses.9: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
verses.10: More to be desired are they than gold, Yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.11: Moreover by them Your servant is warned, And in keeping them there is great reward.
verses.12: Who can understand his errors? Cleanse me from secret faults.
verses.13: Keep back Your servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, And I shall be innocent of great transgression.
verses.14: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord , my strength and my Redeemer.

verses.1: A Song of Degrees. When the Lord turned the captivity of Sion, we became as comforted ones.
verses.2: Then was our mouth filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation: then would they say among the Gentiles,
verses.3: The Lord has done great things among them. The Lord has done great things for us, we became joyful.
verses.4: Turn, O Lord, our captivity, as the streams in the south.
verses.5: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.6: They went on and wept as they cast their seeds; but they shall surely come with exultation, bringing their sheaves with them.

bible/NKJV-022.html.title: Psalm 22 NKJV - The Suffering, Praise, and Posterity of - Bible Gateway

verses.1: My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me? Why are You so far from helping Me, And from the words of My groaning?
verses.2: O My God, I cry in the daytime, but You do not hear; And in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.3: But You are holy, Enthroned in the praises of Israel.
verses.4: Our fathers trusted in You; They trusted, and You delivered them.
verses.5: They cried to You, and were delivered; They trusted in You, and were not ashamed.
verses.6: But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised by the people.
verses.7: All those who see Me ridicule Me; They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.8: “He trusted in the Lord , let Him rescue Him; Let Him deliver Him, since He delights in Him!”
verses.9: But You are He who took Me out of the womb; You made Me trust while on My mother’s breasts.
verses.10: I was cast upon You from birth. From My mother’s womb You have been My God.
verses.11: Be not far from Me, For trouble is near; For there is none to help.
verses.12: Many bulls have surrounded Me; Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled Me.
verses.13: They gape at Me with their mouths, Like a raging and roaring lion.
verses.14: I am poured out like water, And all My bones are out of joint; My heart is like wax; It has melted within Me.
verses.15: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, And My tongue clings to My jaws; You have brought Me to the dust of death.
verses.16: For dogs have surrounded Me; The congregation of the wicked has enclosed Me. They pierced My hands and My feet;
verses.17: I can count all My bones. They look and stare at Me.
verses.18: They divide My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots.
verses.19: But You, O Lord , do not be far from Me; O My Strength, hasten to help Me!
verses.20: Deliver Me from the sword, My precious life from the power of the dog.
verses.21: Save Me from the lion’s mouth And from the horns of the wild oxen! You have answered Me.
verses.22: I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You.
verses.23: You who fear the Lord , praise Him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And fear Him, all you offspring of Israel!
verses.24: For He has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Nor has He hidden His face from Him; But when He cried to Him, He heard.
verses.25: My praise shall be of You in the great assembly; I will pay My vows before those who fear Him.
verses.26: The poor shall eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the Lord . Let your heart live forever!
verses.27: All the ends of the world Shall remember and turn to the Lord , And all the families of the nations Shall worship before You.
verses.28: For the kingdom is the Lord ’s, And He rules over the nations.
verses.29: All the prosperous of the earth Shall eat and worship; All those who go down to the dust Shall bow before Him, Even he who cannot keep himself alive.
verses.30: A posterity shall serve Him. It will be recounted of the Lord to the next generation,
verses.31: They will come and declare His righteousness to a people who will be born, That He has done this.

bible/NKJV-020.html.title: Psalm 20 NKJV - The Assurance of God’s Saving Work - Bible Gateway

verses.1: May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble; May the name of the God of Jacob defend you;
verses.2: May He send you help from the sanctuary, And strengthen you out of Zion;
verses.3: May He remember all your offerings, And accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah
verses.4: May He grant you according to your heart’s desire, And fulfill all your purpose.
verses.5: We will rejoice in your salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners! May the Lord fulfill all your petitions.
verses.6: Now I know that the Lord saves His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the saving strength of His right hand.
verses.7: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will remember the name of the Lord our God.
verses.8: They have bowed down and fallen; But we have risen and stand upright.
verses.9: Save, Lord ! May the King answer us when we call.

bible/NKJV-023.html.title: Psalm 23 NKJV - The Lord the Shepherd of His People - A - Bible Gateway

verses.1: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.2: He makes me to lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside the still waters.
verses.3: He restores my soul; He leads me in the paths of righteousness For His name’s sake.
verses.4: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
verses.5: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.
verses.6: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the Lord Forever.

bible/NKJV-024.html.title: Psalm 24 NKJV - The King of Glory and His Kingdom - A - Bible Gateway

verses.1: The earth is the Lord ’s, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell therein.
verses.2: For He has founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the waters.
verses.3: Who may ascend into the hill of the Lord ? Or who may stand in His holy place?
verses.4: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to an idol, Nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.5: He shall receive blessing from the Lord , And righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.6: This is Jacob, the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face. Selah
verses.7: Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.
verses.8: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, The Lord mighty in battle.
verses.9: Lift up your heads, O you gates! Lift up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.
verses.10: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah

bible/NKJV-034.html.title: Psalm 34 NKJV - The Happiness of Those Who Trust in God - Bible Gateway

verses.1: I will bless the Lord at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.2: My soul shall make its boast in the Lord ; The humble shall hear of it and be glad.
verses.3: Oh, magnify the Lord with me, And let us exalt His name together.
verses.4: I sought the Lord , and He heard me, And delivered me from all my fears.
verses.5: They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.
verses.6: This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.7: The angel of the Lord encamps all around those who fear Him, And delivers them.
verses.8: Oh, taste and see that the Lord is good; Blessed is the man who trusts in Him!
verses.9: Oh, fear the Lord , you His saints! There is no want to those who fear Him.
verses.10: The young lions lack and suffer hunger; But those who seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing.
verses.11: Come, you children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .
verses.12: Who is the man who desires life, And loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.13: Keep your tongue from evil, And your lips from speaking deceit.
verses.14: Depart from evil and do good; Seek peace and pursue it.
verses.15: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, And His ears are open to their cry.
verses.16: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.17: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears, And delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.18: The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart, And saves such as have a contrite spirit.
verses.19: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, But the Lord delivers him out of them all.
verses.20: He guards all his bones; Not one of them is broken.
verses.21: Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.
verses.22: The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who trust in Him shall be condemned.

bible/NKJV-031.html.title: Psalm 31 NKJV - The Lord a Fortress in Adversity - To - Bible Gateway

verses.1: In You, O Lord , I put my trust; Let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Your righteousness.
verses.2: Bow down Your ear to me, Deliver me speedily; Be my rock of refuge, A fortress of defense to save me.
verses.3: For You are my rock and my fortress; Therefore, for Your name’s sake, Lead me and guide me.
verses.4: Pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.
verses.5: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.
verses.6: I have hated those who regard useless idols; But I trust in the Lord .
verses.7: I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy, For You have considered my trouble; You have known my soul in adversities,
verses.8: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a wide place.
verses.9: Have mercy on me, O Lord , for I am in trouble; My eye wastes away with grief, Yes, my soul and my body!
verses.10: For my life is spent with grief, And my years with sighing; My strength fails because of my iniquity, And my bones waste away.
verses.11: I am a reproach among all my enemies, But especially among my neighbors, And am repulsive to my acquaintances; Those who see me outside flee from me.
verses.12: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.
verses.13: For I hear the slander of many; Fear is on every side; While they take counsel together against me, They scheme to take away my life.
verses.14: But as for me, I trust in You, O Lord ; I say, “You are my God.”
verses.15: My times are in Your hand; Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from those who persecute me.
verses.16: Make Your face shine upon Your servant; Save me for Your mercies’ sake.
verses.17: Do not let me be ashamed, O Lord , for I have called upon You; Let the wicked be ashamed; Let them be silent in the grave.
verses.18: Let the lying lips be put to silence, Which speak insolent things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.19: Oh, how great is Your goodness, Which You have laid up for those who fear You, Which You have prepared for those who trust in You In the presence of the sons of men!
verses.20: You shall hide them in the secret place of Your presence From the plots of man; You shall keep them secretly in a pavilion From the strife of tongues.
verses.21: Blessed be the Lord , For He has shown me His marvelous kindness in a strong city!
verses.22: For I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before Your eyes”; Nevertheless You heard the voice of my supplications When I cried out to You.
verses.23: Oh, love the Lord , all you His saints! For the Lord preserves the faithful, And fully repays the proud person.
verses.24: Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart, All you who hope in the Lord .

bible/NKJV-038.html.title: Psalm 38:1-2,21 NKJV - Prayer in Time of Chastening - A Psalm - Bible Gateway

verses.1: O Lord , do not rebuke me in Your wrath, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure!
verses.2: For Your arrows pierce me deeply, And Your hand presses me down.

bible/NKJV-044.html.title: Psalm 44 NKJV - Redemption Remembered in Present - Bible Gateway

verses.1: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, The deeds You did in their days, In days of old:
verses.2: You drove out the nations with Your hand, But them You planted; You afflicted the peoples, and cast them out.
verses.3: For they did not gain possession of the land by their own sword, Nor did their own arm save them; But it was Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your countenance, Because You favored them.
verses.4: You are my King, O God; Command victories for Jacob.
verses.5: Through You we will push down our enemies; Through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.
verses.6: For I will not trust in my bow, Nor shall my sword save me.
verses.7: But You have saved us from our enemies, And have put to shame those who hated us.
verses.8: In God we boast all day long, And praise Your name forever. Selah
verses.9: But You have cast us off and put us to shame, And You do not go out with our armies.
verses.10: You make us turn back from the enemy, And those who hate us have taken spoil for themselves.
verses.11: You have given us up like sheep intended for food, And have scattered us among the nations.
verses.12: You sell Your people for next to nothing, And are not enriched by selling them.
verses.13: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and a derision to those all around us.
verses.14: You make us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.15: My dishonor is continually before me, And the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.16: Because of the voice of him who reproaches and reviles, Because of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.17: All this has come upon us; But we have not forgotten You, Nor have we dealt falsely with Your covenant.
verses.18: Our heart has not turned back, Nor have our steps departed from Your way;
verses.19: But You have severely broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.20: If we had forgotten the name of our God, Or stretched out our hands to a foreign god,
verses.21: Would not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.22: Yet for Your sake we are killed all day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.23: Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise! Do not cast us off forever.
verses.24: Why do You hide Your face, And forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.25: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; Our body clings to the ground.
verses.26: Arise for our help, And redeem us for Your mercies’ sake.

bible/NKJV-041.html.title: Psalm 41 NKJV - The Blessing and Suffering of the Godly - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Blessed is he who considers the poor; The Lord will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.2: The Lord will preserve him and keep him alive, And he will be blessed on the earth; You will not deliver him to the will of his enemies.
verses.3: The Lord will strengthen him on his bed of illness; You will sustain him on his sickbed.
verses.4: I said, “ Lord , be merciful to me; Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You.”
verses.5: My enemies speak evil of me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”
verses.6: And if he comes to see me, he speaks lies; His heart gathers iniquity to itself; When he goes out, he tells it.
verses.7: All who hate me whisper together against me; Against me they devise my hurt.
verses.8: “An evil disease,” they say, “clings to him. And now that he lies down, he will rise up no more.”
verses.9: Even my own familiar friend in whom I trusted, Who ate my bread, Has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.10: But You, O Lord , be merciful to me, and raise me up, That I may repay them.
verses.11: By this I know that You are well pleased with me, Because my enemy does not triumph over me.
verses.12: As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And set me before Your face forever.
verses.13: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.

bible/NKJV-045.html.title: Psalm 45 NKJV - The Glories of the Messiah and His - Bible Gateway

verses.1: My heart is overflowing with a good theme; I recite my composition concerning the King; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.2: You are fairer than the sons of men; Grace is poured upon Your lips; Therefore God has blessed You forever.
verses.3: Gird Your sword upon Your thigh, O Mighty One, With Your glory and Your majesty.
verses.4: And in Your majesty ride prosperously because of truth, humility, and righteousness; And Your right hand shall teach You awesome things.
verses.5: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the King’s enemies; The peoples fall under You.
verses.6: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; A scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.
verses.7: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of gladness more than Your companions.
verses.8: All Your garments are scented with myrrh and aloes and cassia, Out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.
verses.9: Kings’ daughters are among Your honorable women; At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.
verses.10: Listen, O daughter, Consider and incline your ear; Forget your own people also, and your father’s house;
verses.11: So the King will greatly desire your beauty; Because He is your Lord, worship Him.
verses.12: And the daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; The rich among the people will seek your favor.
verses.13: The royal daughter is all glorious within the palace; Her clothing is woven with gold.
verses.14: She shall be brought to the King in robes of many colors; The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to You.
verses.15: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be brought; They shall enter the King’s palace.
verses.16: Instead of Your fathers shall be Your sons, Whom You shall make princes in all the earth.
verses.17: I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever.

bible/NKJV-046.html.title: Psalm 46 NKJV - God the Refuge of His People and - Bible Gateway

verses.1: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
verses.2: Therefore we will not fear, Even though the earth be removed, And though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
verses.3: Though its waters roar and be troubled, Though the mountains shake with its swelling. Selah
verses.4: There is a river whose streams shall make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacle of the Most High.
verses.5: God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, just at the break of dawn.
verses.6: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

verses.1: O Lord , God of my salvation, I have cried out day and night before You.
verses.2: Let my prayer come before You; Incline Your ear to my cry.
verses.3: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draws near to the grave.
verses.4: I am counted with those who go down to the pit; I am like a man who has no strength,
verses.5: Adrift among the dead, Like the slain who lie in the grave, Whom You remember no more, And who are cut off from Your hand.
verses.6: You have laid me in the lowest pit, In darkness, in the depths.
verses.7: Your wrath lies heavy upon me, And You have afflicted me with all Your waves. Selah
verses.8: You have put away my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an abomination to them; I am shut up, and I cannot get out;
verses.9: My eye wastes away because of affliction. Lord , I have called daily upon You; I have stretched out my hands to You.
verses.10: Will You work wonders for the dead? Shall the dead arise and praise You? Selah
verses.11: Shall Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or Your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
verses.12: Shall Your wonders be known in the dark? And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.13: But to You I have cried out, O Lord , And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
verses.14: Lord , why do You cast off my soul? Why do You hide Your face from me?
verses.15: I have been afflicted and ready to die from my youth; I suffer Your terrors; I am distraught.
verses.16: Your fierce wrath has gone over me; Your terrors have cut me off.
verses.17: They came around me all day long like water; They engulfed me altogether.
verses.18: Loved one and friend You have put far from me, And my acquaintances into darkness.

bible/NKJV-092.html.title: Psalm 92 NKJV - Praise to the Lord for His Love and - Bible Gateway

verses.1: It is good to give thanks to the Lord , And to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;
verses.2: To declare Your lovingkindness in the morning, And Your faithfulness every night,
verses.3: On an instrument of ten strings, On the lute, And on the harp, With harmonious sound.
verses.4: For You, Lord , have made me glad through Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.
verses.5: O Lord , how great are Your works! Your thoughts are very deep.
verses.6: A senseless man does not know, Nor does a fool understand this.
verses.7: When the wicked spring up like grass, And when all the workers of iniquity flourish, It is that they may be destroyed forever.
verses.8: But You, Lord , are on high forevermore.
verses.9: For behold, Your enemies, O Lord , For behold, Your enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.10: But my horn You have exalted like a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.
verses.11: My eye also has seen my desire on my enemies; My ears hear my desire on the wicked Who rise up against me.
verses.12: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.13: Those who are planted in the house of the Lord Shall flourish in the courts of our God.
verses.14: They shall still bear fruit in old age; They shall be fresh and flourishing,
verses.15: To declare that the Lord is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.

bible/NKJV-097.html.title: Psalm 97 NKJV - A Song of Praise to the Sovereign Lord - Bible Gateway

verses.1: The Lord reigns; Let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad!
verses.2: Clouds and darkness surround Him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
verses.3: A fire goes before Him, And burns up His enemies round about.
verses.4: His lightnings light the world; The earth sees and trembles.
verses.5: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the Lord , At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.6: The heavens declare His righteousness, And all the peoples see His glory.
verses.7: Let all be put to shame who serve carved images, Who boast of idols. Worship Him, all you gods.
verses.8: Zion hears and is glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments, O Lord .
verses.9: For You, Lord , are most high above all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
verses.10: You who love the Lord , hate evil! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.11: Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.12: Rejoice in the Lord , you righteous, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.

bible/NKJV-102.html.title: Psalm 102 NKJV - The Lord’s Eternal Love - A Prayer of - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Hear my prayer, O Lord , And let my cry come to You.
verses.2: Do not hide Your face from me in the day of my trouble; Incline Your ear to me; In the day that I call, answer me speedily.
verses.3: For my days are consumed like smoke, And my bones are burned like a hearth.
verses.4: My heart is stricken and withered like grass, So that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.5: Because of the sound of my groaning My bones cling to my skin.
verses.6: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.7: I lie awake, And am like a sparrow alone on the housetop.
verses.8: My enemies reproach me all day long; Those who deride me swear an oath against me.
verses.9: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.10: Because of Your indignation and Your wrath; For You have lifted me up and cast me away.
verses.11: My days are like a shadow that lengthens, And I wither away like grass.
verses.12: But You, O Lord , shall endure forever, And the remembrance of Your name to all generations.
verses.13: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; For the time to favor her, Yes, the set time, has come.
verses.14: For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, And show favor to her dust.
verses.15: So the nations shall fear the name of the Lord , And all the kings of the earth Your glory.
verses.16: For the Lord shall build up Zion; He shall appear in His glory.
verses.17: He shall regard the prayer of the destitute, And shall not despise their prayer.
verses.18: This will be written for the generation to come, That a people yet to be created may praise the Lord .
verses.19: For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven the Lord viewed the earth,
verses.20: To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To release those appointed to death,
verses.21: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem,
verses.22: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the Lord .
verses.23: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.
verses.24: I said, “O my God, Do not take me away in the midst of my days; Your years are throughout all generations.
verses.25: Of old You laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.
verses.26: They will perish, but You will endure; Yes, they will all grow old like a garment; Like a cloak You will change them, And they will be changed.
verses.27: But You are the same, And Your years will have no end.
verses.28: The children of Your servants will continue, And their descendants will be established before You.”

bible/NKJV-105.html.title: Psalm 105 NKJV - The Eternal Faithfulness of the Lord - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Oh, give thanks to the Lord ! Call upon His name; Make known His deeds among the peoples!
verses.2: Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!
verses.3: Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the Lord !
verses.4: Seek the Lord and His strength; Seek His face evermore!
verses.5: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.6: O seed of Abraham His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!
verses.7: He is the Lord our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.8: He remembers His covenant forever, The word which He commanded, for a thousand generations,
verses.9: The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,
verses.10: And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.11: Saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,”
verses.12: When they were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.
verses.13: When they went from one nation to another, From one kingdom to another people,
verses.14: He permitted no one to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,
verses.15: Saying, “Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.”
verses.16: Moreover He called for a famine in the land; He destroyed all the provision of bread.
verses.17: He sent a man before them— Joseph— who was sold as a slave.
verses.18: They hurt his feet with fetters, He was laid in irons.
verses.19: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the Lord tested him.
verses.20: The king sent and released him, The ruler of the people let him go free.
verses.21: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions,
verses.22: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.
verses.23: Israel also came into Egypt, And Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
verses.24: He increased His people greatly, And made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.25: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.
verses.26: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.
verses.27: They performed His signs among them, And wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.28: He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they did not rebel against His word.
verses.29: He turned their waters into blood, And killed their fish.
verses.30: Their land abounded with frogs, Even in the chambers of their kings.
verses.31: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their territory.
verses.32: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
verses.33: He struck their vines also, and their fig trees, And splintered the trees of their territory.
verses.34: He spoke, and locusts came, Young locusts without number,
verses.35: And ate up all the vegetation in their land, And devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.36: He also destroyed all the firstborn in their land, The first of all their strength.
verses.37: He also brought them out with silver and gold, And there was none feeble among His tribes.
verses.38: Egypt was glad when they departed, For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.39: He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.
verses.40: The people asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.41: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; It ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.42: For He remembered His holy promise, And Abraham His servant.
verses.43: He brought out His people with joy, His chosen ones with gladness.
verses.44: He gave them the lands of the Gentiles, And they inherited the labor of the nations,
verses.45: That they might observe His statutes And keep His laws. Praise the Lord !

bible/NKJV-104.html.title: Psalm 104 NKJV - Praise to the Sovereign Lord for His - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Bless the Lord , O my soul! O Lord my God, You are very great: You are clothed with honor and majesty,
verses.2: Who cover Yourself with light as with a garment, Who stretch out the heavens like a curtain.
verses.3: He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, Who makes the clouds His chariot, Who walks on the wings of the wind,
verses.4: Who makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flame of fire.
verses.5: You who laid the foundations of the earth, So that it should not be moved forever,
verses.6: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; The waters stood above the mountains.
verses.7: At Your rebuke they fled; At the voice of Your thunder they hastened away.
verses.8: They went up over the mountains; They went down into the valleys, To the place which You founded for them.
verses.9: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, That they may not return to cover the earth.
verses.10: He sends the springs into the valleys; They flow among the hills.
verses.11: They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.
verses.12: By them the birds of the heavens have their home; They sing among the branches.
verses.13: He waters the hills from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.
verses.14: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the service of man, That he may bring forth food from the earth,
verses.15: And wine that makes glad the heart of man, Oil to make his face shine, And bread which strengthens man’s heart.
verses.16: The trees of the Lord are full of sap, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,
verses.17: Where the birds make their nests; The stork has her home in the fir trees.
verses.18: The high hills are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock badgers.
verses.19: He appointed the moon for seasons; The sun knows its going down.
verses.20: You make darkness, and it is night, In which all the beasts of the forest creep about.
verses.21: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
verses.22: When the sun rises, they gather together And lie down in their dens.
verses.23: Man goes out to his work And to his labor until the evening.
verses.24: O Lord , how manifold are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all. The earth is full of Your possessions—
verses.25: This great and wide sea, In which are innumerable teeming things, Living things both small and great.
verses.26: There the ships sail about; There is that Leviathan Which You have made to play there.
verses.27: These all wait for You, That You may give them their food in due season.
verses.28: What You give them they gather in; You open Your hand, they are filled with good.
verses.29: You hide Your face, they are troubled; You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.
verses.30: You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the earth.
verses.31: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; May the Lord rejoice in His works.
verses.32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the hills, and they smoke.
verses.33: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
verses.34: May my meditation be sweet to Him; I will be glad in the Lord .
verses.35: May sinners be consumed from the earth, And the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord , O my soul! Praise the Lord !

bible/NKJV-115.html.title: Psalm 115 NKJV - The Futility of Idols and the - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Not unto us, O Lord , not unto us, But to Your name give glory, Because of Your mercy, Because of Your truth.
verses.2: Why should the Gentiles say, “So where is their God?”
verses.3: But our God is in heaven; He does whatever He pleases.
verses.4: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men’s hands.
verses.5: They have mouths, but they do not speak; Eyes they have, but they do not see;
verses.6: They have ears, but they do not hear; Noses they have, but they do not smell;
verses.7: They have hands, but they do not handle; Feet they have, but they do not walk; Nor do they mutter through their throat.
verses.8: Those who make them are like them; So is everyone who trusts in them.
verses.9: O Israel, trust in the Lord ; He is their help and their shield.
verses.10: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord ; He is their help and their shield.
verses.11: You who fear the Lord , trust in the Lord ; He is their help and their shield.
verses.12: The Lord has been mindful of us; He will bless us; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.13: He will bless those who fear the Lord , Both small and great.
verses.14: May the Lord give you increase more and more, You and your children.
verses.15: May you be blessed by the Lord , Who made heaven and earth.
verses.16: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord ’s; But the earth He has given to the children of men.
verses.17: The dead do not praise the Lord , Nor any who go down into silence.
verses.18: But we will bless the Lord From this time forth and forevermore. Praise the Lord !

bible/NKJV-118.html.title: Psalm 118 NKJV - Praise to God for His Everlasting Mercy - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Oh, give thanks to the Lord , for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.
verses.2: Let Israel now say, “His mercy endures forever.”
verses.3: Let the house of Aaron now say, “His mercy endures forever.”
verses.4: Let those who fear the Lord now say, “His mercy endures forever.”
verses.5: I called on the Lord in distress; The Lord answered me and set me in a broad place.
verses.6: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?
verses.7: The Lord is for me among those who help me; Therefore I shall see my desire on those who hate me.
verses.8: It is better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in man.
verses.9: It is better to trust in the Lord Than to put confidence in princes.
verses.10: All nations surrounded me, But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.11: They surrounded me, Yes, they surrounded me; But in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.12: They surrounded me like bees; They were quenched like a fire of thorns; For in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.
verses.13: You pushed me violently, that I might fall, But the Lord helped me.
verses.14: The Lord is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.
verses.15: The voice of rejoicing and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
verses.16: The right hand of the Lord is exalted; The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.
verses.17: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the Lord .
verses.18: The Lord has chastened me severely, But He has not given me over to death.
verses.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go through them, And I will praise the Lord .
verses.20: This is the gate of the Lord , Through which the righteous shall enter.
verses.21: I will praise You, For You have answered me, And have become my salvation.
verses.22: The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone.
verses.23: This was the Lord ’s doing; It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.24: This is the day the Lord has made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.25: Save now, I pray, O Lord ; O Lord , I pray, send now prosperity.
verses.26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord ! We have blessed you from the house of the Lord .
verses.27: God is the Lord , And He has given us light; Bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
verses.28: You are my God, and I will praise You; You are my God, I will exalt You.
verses.29: Oh, give thanks to the Lord , for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.

bible/NKJV-126.html.title: Psalm 126 NKJV - A Joyful Return to Zion - A Song of - Bible Gateway

verses.1: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Zion, We were like those who dream.
verses.2: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The Lord has done great things for them.”
verses.3: The Lord has done great things for us, And we are glad.
verses.4: Bring back our captivity, O Lord , As the streams in the South.
verses.5: Those who sow in tears Shall reap in joy.
verses.6: He who continually goes forth weeping, Bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, Bringing his sheaves with him.

bible/NKJV-128.html.title: Psalm 128:3-4 NKJV - Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine - Bible Gateway

verses.3: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine In the very heart of your house, Your children like olive plants All around your table.
verses.4: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed Who fears the Lord .

bible/NKJV-147.html.title: Psalm 147 NKJV - Praise to God for His Word and - Bible Gateway

verses.1: Praise the Lord ! For it is good to sing praises to our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is beautiful.
verses.2: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.
verses.3: He heals the brokenhearted And binds up their wounds.
verses.4: He counts the number of the stars; He calls them all by name.
verses.5: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.
verses.6: The Lord lifts up the humble; He casts the wicked down to the ground.
verses.7: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; Sing praises on the harp to our God,
verses.8: Who covers the heavens with clouds, Who prepares rain for the earth, Who makes grass to grow on the mountains.
verses.9: He gives to the beast its food, And to the young ravens that cry.
verses.10: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.11: The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him, In those who hope in His mercy.
verses.12: Praise the Lord , O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!
verses.13: For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your children within you.
verses.14: He makes peace in your borders, And fills you with the finest wheat.
verses.15: He sends out His command to the earth; His word runs very swiftly.
verses.16: He gives snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
verses.17: He casts out His hail like morsels; Who can stand before His cold?
verses.18: He sends out His word and melts them; He causes His wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.19: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and His judgments to Israel.
verses.20: He has not dealt thus with any nation; And as for His judgments, they have not known them. Praise the Lord !

bible/NKJV-138.html.title: Psalm 138 NKJV - The Lord’s Goodness to the Faithful - Bible Gateway

verses.1: I will praise You with my whole heart; Before the gods I will sing praises to You.
verses.2: I will worship toward Your holy temple, And praise Your name For Your lovingkindness and Your truth; For You have magnified Your word above all Your name.
verses.3: In the day when I cried out, You answered me, And made me bold with strength in my soul.
verses.4: All the kings of the earth shall praise You, O Lord , When they hear the words of Your mouth.
verses.5: Yes, they shall sing of the ways of the Lord , For great is the glory of the Lord .
verses.6: Though the Lord is on high, Yet He regards the lowly; But the proud He knows from afar.
verses.7: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You will revive me; You will stretch out Your hand Against the wrath of my enemies, And Your right hand will save me.
verses.8: The Lord will perfect that which concerns me; Your mercy, O Lord , endures forever; Do not forsake the works of Your hands.
